summary.en: The Hong Kong Open badminton championships reached the quarter-final stage today at Kai Tak Arena. India's men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty beat China's Hu Ke Yuan and Lin Xiang Yi 21-12, 13-21, 21-16 to reach the semi-finals. In women's singles, top seed and defending champion Wang Zhiyi edged Indonesia's sixth seed Putri Kusuma Wardani 22-20, 22-20 to advance, and will face Japan's Tomoka Miyazaki for a place in the final. India's surprise package Rakshitha Ramraj saw her run end with a quarter-final defeat to Thailand's fifth seed Pornpawee Chochuwong, after stunning China's second seed Chen Yufei in the last 16.
summary.zh_hans: 香港公开羽毛球锦标赛今日在启德体艺馆上演八强赛。印度男双组合萨维克塞拉及施拉杰以 21-12、13-21、21-16 力克中国的胡珂源及林祥毅，率先闯入四强。女单方面，头号种子、卫冕冠军王祉怡以 22-20、22-20 险胜印尼六号种子华丹妮，晋级四强，将与日本的宫崎友花争入决赛。印度黑马拉克希塔的惊喜之旅告一段落，她在八强不敌泰国五号种子蓬帕威；此前拉克希塔在十六强爆冷淘汰中国二号种子陈雨菲。

summary.en: George Russell went fastest in a wet second practice for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the first competitive running of the weekend after the opening session was washed out with no timed laps. The Mercedes driver posted 1:47.272 on his final lap, 0.071s clear of Alpine's Pierre Gasly, with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc third on 1:47.605, 0.333s back; Isack Hadjar was fourth, Oscar Piastri fifth, Lewis Hamilton sixth, Lando Norris seventh and Kimi Antonelli eighth. Red Bull's Max Verstappen, troubled by power-unit problems, completed only nine laps and was 13th on 1:50.141, 2.869s off the pace. Drivers started on full wet tyres before switching to intermediates midway through, and the session was briefly red-flagged late on when plastic debris appeared on the track.
summary.zh_hans: 拉塞尔在湿滑的拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二次练习赛压线做出最快时间，为本站首个真正有竞争的练习时段，此前首节练习因大雨取消，未有车手做出计时圈。拉塞尔在最后一圈做出 1 分 47.272 秒，以 0.071 秒力压 Alpine 的加斯利，法拉利的勒克莱尔以 1 分 47.605 秒排第三，落后 0.333 秒；哈贾尔第四，皮亚斯特里第五，咸美顿第六，诺里斯第七，安东尼利第八。红牛的维斯塔潘受动力单元问题困扰，全节只跑 9 圈，最快 1 分 50.141 秒，仅排第 13 位，落后 2.869 秒。练习赛中段车手由全雨胎转用中性胎，尾段因赛道出现塑胶碎片短暂出示红旗。
summary.zh_hant: 拉塞爾在濕滑的拉斯維加斯大獎賽第二次練習賽壓線做出最快時間，為本站首個真正有競爭的練習時段，此前首節練習因大雨取消，未有車手做出計時圈。拉塞爾在最後一圈做出 1 分 47.272 秒，以 0.071 秒力壓 Alpine 的加斯利，法拉利的勒克萊爾以 1 分 47.605 秒排第三，落後 0.333 秒；哈賈爾第四，皮亞斯特里第五，咸美頓第六，諾里斯第七，安東尼利第八。紅牛的維斯塔潘受動力單元問題困擾，全節只跑 9 圈，最快 1 分 50.141 秒，僅排第 13 位，落後 2.869 秒。練習賽中段車手由全雨胎轉用中性胎，尾段因賽道出現塑膠碎片短暫出示紅旗。

summary.en: Four NBA regular-season games on November 19 US time. The Grizzlies beat the Warriors 126-98 at home by 28 points, with Jaylen Wells scoring 22 and Cedric Coward adding 19, while Charles Bassey had 16 points and 13 rebounds for Golden State. The Trail Blazers won 124-114 at Milwaukee, as Damian Lillard scored a season-high 33 on his first return to Milwaukee since being waived by the Bucks in the summer of 2025, with Scoot Henderson adding 27 and Jrue Holiday 22; the Bucks suffered a 12th straight loss to fall to 1-15. The Knicks edged the Timberwolves 102-99 on the road, with Karl-Anthony Towns posting 22 points and 12 rebounds and Jalen Brunson adding 21, while Jonathan Kuminga scored 23 for Minnesota. The Spurs beat the Clippers 124-112 at home, with Victor Wembanyama posting 32 points and 11 rebounds and Stephon Castle adding 21 points and 12 assists; Brook Lopez and Darius Garland each scored 23 for the Clippers.

summary.en: The first practice session of the Las Vegas Grand Prix was washed out by heavy rain, with none of the 22 drivers setting a timed lap. Sergio Perez was classified first simply by being the first driver to venture out, five minutes into the session, completing a single installation lap before returning to the pits. Ryo Hirakawa, Rafael Camara and others also managed only exploratory laps. Valtteri Bottas had a hairy moment on standing water at Turn 12, while Kimi Antonelli reported aquaplaning everywhere and Alex Albon also had a moment at Turn 14. Conditions are expected to improve for the second practice session.

summary.en: At the Hong Kong Open badminton championships, China's men's doubles pair Liang Weikeng and Wang Chang came from a game down to beat their Malaysian opponents 19-21, 21-18, 21-19 and reach the quarterfinals. Two other Chinese men's doubles pairs, Hu Keyuan and Lin Xiangyi, and He Jiting and Ren Xiangyu, also booked quarterfinal places. In men's singles, Zhu Xuanchen was the only Chinese player to reach the last eight. Earlier, Wang Zhiyi advanced to the women's singles quarterfinals, while world No. 4 Chen Yufei was upset in straight games by India's Rakshitha Ramraj.

summary.en: India's Lakshya Sen beat Singapore's eighth seed Loh Kean Yew 21-17, 10-21, 21-13 in the Hong Kong Open men's singles quarter-finals today at Kai Tak Arena to reach the semi-finals, where he will face the winner of Denmark's third seed Anders Antonsen and China's Zhu Xuanchen. Sen has also secured a place at the BWF World Tour Finals 2026. In men's doubles, second seeds and defending champions Liang Weikeng and Wang Chang crashed out 19-21, 21-19, 18-21 to South Korea's world No. 97 pair Kang Min-hyuk and Lee Jong-min. Malaysia's eighth seeds Man Wei Chong and Tee Kai Wun beat Denmark's Daniel Lundgaard and Mads Vestergaard 21-16, 21-16 to set up a semi-final against India's Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty. The women's singles semi-finals are set: Wang Zhiyi against Tomoka Miyazaki, and Ratchanok Intanon against Pornpawee Chochuwong.

summary.en: The Portland Trail Blazers beat the Milwaukee Bucks 124-114 on the road, with Damian Lillard scoring a season-high 33 points on his return to Milwaukee and Scoot Henderson adding a season-high 27, handing the Bucks a 12th straight defeat. The San Antonio Spurs beat the LA Clippers 124-112 at home as Victor Wembanyama posted 32 points and 11 rebounds and Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, the Spurs' 13th win in 14 games. The New York Knicks edged the Minnesota Timberwolves 102-99 on the road, Karl-Anthony Towns scoring 22 points and 12 rebounds against his former team and Jalen Brunson adding 21; Minnesota rallied from 19 points down before LaMelo Ball missed a tying three with 9.9 seconds left.
